evaluation_config.precision: FP16 model and input (quantize=16); inherited amp=bf16 is the training setting, not evaluator precision
evaluation_config.backend: Native PyTorch AutoBackend, default fuse=true; end-to-end head retained
evaluation_config.split_selection: Exact approved records; train/val-only development YAML; no discovery, fallback, download or split override. Test runner remains separately gated.
evaluation_config.rectangular_order: Installed NumPy aspect-ratio argsort; batch=8; ceil(batch_shape*640/32+0.5)*32; no shuffle
evaluation_config.preprocessing: Installed OpenCV primary decode; INTER_LINEAR resize with ceil and long side 640; LetterBox scaleup=false, default centered padding 114; BGR to RGB, CHW, divide by 255
evaluation_config.exif_policy: Use installed decode orientation; header dimensions swap for EXIF 6/8; retain every normalized source box in the reviewed oriented frame; no extra box rotation
evaluation_config.raw_safeguards: Read-only label checks; no label rewrite/dedup, repair, image/label cache or raw-adjacent NPY reads/writes; no automatic downloads/integrations
evaluation_config.determinism_scope: seed=42 and deterministic=true retained in args; fixed records/order and installed source versions. Standalone replay does not add trainer init_seeds; no stronger bitwise guarantee claimed.

split_binding: Exact approved test records; evaluator split=test
